description: Scaffold the npm-workspaces monorepo root and the shared package (pure game logic + types) that both frontend and backend depend on. This is the testable core and the ONLY package whose tests can run in this sandbox (node:test, zero external deps). Root config, tsconfigs, .gitignore, and shared logic all live here.
steps: Create root package.json with npm workspaces: ["packages/*", "infra"], name "kiro-digitalmonster", private true, scripts: "build" (build shared, backend, frontend, infra in order), "test" (runs shared tests), "synth" (cd infra && cdk synth). Use "workspaces" field.
Create tsconfig.base.json at root with strict:true, target ES2022, module NodeNext/ESNext as appropriate, moduleResolution, esModuleInterop, skipLibCheck true, declaration true for shared.
Create .gitignore covering node_modules, dist, cdk.out, .env, *.log, coverage, .DS_Store.
Create packages/shared/package.json (name @ddm/shared, type module, main dist/index.js, types dist/index.d.ts, scripts build=tsc, test='node --test').
Create packages/shared/tsconfig.json extending base, outDir dist, rootDir src.

Create packages/shared/src/types.ts: Monster interface (id, name, stageId, stats {hp, maxHp, atk, def}, trainingCount, careCounters {feed, sleep, clean}, bornAt, lastUpdatedAt, status flags like isSleeping/dirty/hungryLevel), GrowthStage type/enum ('baby'|'rookie'|'champion'|'ultimate'), and request/response DTOs (SaveMonster, GetMonster, ChatRequest, ChatResponse, BattleRequest, BattleResult).

Create packages/shared/src/stages.ts: STAGES config array mapping each stage to {id, labelJa (幼年期/成長期/成熟期/完全体), canChat boolean, bedrockModelKey ('none'|'haiku'|'sonnet'|'opus'), baseStats}. Export evolveStage(monster, now) implementing evolution by trainingCount + elapsed time thresholds (baby->rookie, rookie->champion, champion->ultimate) returning the new stageId or current.

Create packages/shared/src/game.ts pure functions: applyTimePassage(monster, now) -> advances hunger/dirtiness and small HP changes based on (now-lastUpdatedAt); feed(monster), train(monster) (increments trainingCount, raises atk/def), sleep(monster), clean(monster); each returns a NEW monster object (immutable) and updates lastUpdatedAt. Clamp stats to sane ranges.

Create packages/shared/src/battle.ts: simulateBattle(player, enemy) -> deterministic-ish simple turn loop using atk vs def and hp, returns BattleResult {winner, log[], playerHpAfter}. Allow an optional rng seed param for test determinism.

Create packages/shared/src/bedrock-models.ts: BEDROCK_MODEL_IDS default map {haiku, sonnet, opus} to Anthropic Claude model IDs, with a function resolveModelId(key, overrides?) that reads overrides (from env) first. Export the stage->modelKey helper too.
Create packages/shared/src/index.ts re-exporting all of the above.

Create packages/shared/src/__tests__/game.test.ts and battle.test.ts and stages.test.ts using node:test + node:assert: cover feed/train increments, evolution thresholds (trainingCount+time), time passage effects, battle winner determination with a fixed seed, and bedrock model mapping per stage.
acceptance_criteria: env -u NODE_OPTIONS tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit completes with no errors
env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/shared/src/__tests__/*.ts passes all tests (or compiled-JS equivalent passes)
All package.json and tsconfig files are valid JSON
Evolution logic requires BOTH a training-count threshold and an elapsed-time threshold as specified
findings:
Scaffolded monorepo root (package.json npm workspaces [packages/*, infra], tsconfig.base.json, .gitignore) and packages/shared pure-logic lib. All 22 node:test unit tests pass and tsc --noEmit is clean.

KEY TECHNICAL DECISIONS (important for later features):
- Imports use explicit .ts extensions (required by Node --experimental-strip-types). To let tsc both type-check AND emit, tsconfig.base.json sets allowImportingTsExtensions:true + rewriteRelativeImportExtensions:true (needs TS >=5.7; sandbox has 5.9.2). On emit, .ts import specifiers are rewritten to .js, so dist output is runnable Node ESM. Downstream packages (backend/frontend/infra) extending the base should keep this in mind.
- moduleResolution is 'Bundler', module 'ESNext', verbatimModuleSyntax:true -> all type-only imports MUST use 'import type'.
- @types/node is NOT installable in the sandbox. Added packages/shared/src/node-shims.d.ts with minimal ambient decls for node:test and node:assert/strict so tsc resolves them. In a real install with @types/node this is harmless (declarations merge/supersede). Later packages that need node/aws types will rely on the user's npm install.
- Bedrock default model IDs (packages/shared/src/bedrock-models.ts): haiku=anthropic.claude-3-5-haiku-20241022-v1:0, sonnet=anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0, opus=anthropic.claude-3-opus-20240229-v1:0. Overridable via overrides arg or env vars BEDROCK_MODEL_HAIKU/SONNET/OPUS. README (later feature) must document that exact IDs/region availability may need user confirmation and how to override.
- Evolution requires BOTH minTrainingCount AND minAgeMs (thresholds in stages.ts STAGES[].evolveRequirement). baby->rookie: 2 trains + 1min; rookie->champion: 6 + 5min; champion->ultimate: 12 + 15min. ultimate is terminal (evolveRequirement null).
- game.ts care actions (feed/train/sleep/wake/clean) + applyTimePassage are all immutable (return new Monster) and update lastUpdatedAt; createMonster() helper added for a fresh baby.
- battle.ts simulateBattle(player, enemy, seed?) is deterministic given a seed (mulberry32 rng); terminates within MAX_TURNS=100.
- Package name is @ddm/shared (scope @ddm). Root scripts reference @ddm/backend and @ddm/frontend which do not exist yet (later features create them); root 'npm run build/test' will only work fully once those packages exist.

VERIFICATION RUN: 'env -u NODE_OPTIONS tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit' -> clean. 'env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/shared/src/__tests__/*.ts' -> 22 pass / 0 fail. Full tsc emit also verified (dist created with .js-rewritten imports), then dist removed. SANDBOX NOTE: ALL node/npm/tsc commands must be prefixed with 'env -u NODE_OPTIONS'; npm install is impossible (network INTEGRATIONS_ONLY).
